name: Repercussions
source:
A seemingly innocuous act that we all do is take decisions. Sharad did, too. But what he, and most of us, think as ordinary can turn your life upside down. How? Ascertain the answer by joining Sharad in his journey in "Repercussions".

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/repercussions.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
